releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.13.2 - Continuous Whisper Cooling & Anti-Oscillation Fix:
- Eliminated 0 RPM fan shutoff and sudden 70°C fan blast oscillation.
- Established permanent 28% PWM (~1,800 RPM) whisper floor to continuously exhaust idle heat.
- Implemented smooth non-pulsing linear temperature-to-PWM curve across all thermal states.
- Added 6-second HP EC keepalive to prevent BIOS from reverting to stock 0 RPM curve.
